Orthogonal projection removes marginal modes, giving the exact 9^L+2*5^L+6 mixed-energy law and leading 3^L coefficient. Both marginal and cross Legendre sums are individual Fourier modes. Independent checker performs 7041 exact integer assertions including 3125 direct values and 25 levels of Fourier and Parseval tests. Finite tests only corroborate the general proof.

value.rationale: Same-index dependence of two standard generalized central trinomial specializations is a natural observable unresolved by known marginal modular laws. The theorem gives every finite-block residue fiber, an unexpected exact cancellation of two entire rows, a one-count boundary defect, full support at sharp digit depth four, and a nonzero sharply normalized mixed correlation whose 3^L scale distinguishes true dependence from marginal imbalance. The result is self-contained and offers a concrete test case for multivariate automatic congruence schemes; it is more than a random arbitrary slice or mere small-case tabulation. A generalization to other primes is not asserted.
